scenarios.name: Load Healing Sky homepage and verify main navigation controls
scenarios.criteria: The Healing Sky homepage should load successfully and display the main navigation controls including Sign In and Join Healing Sky.
scenarios.startState: Healing Sky homepage is not yet loaded.
scenarios.endState: Healing Sky homepage is loaded with main navigation controls Sign In and Join Healing Sky visible.

scenarios.name: Open Sign In menu on homepage
scenarios.criteria: Clicking Sign In opens the Sign In menu and displays both the I'm a Client and I'm a Provider options.
scenarios.endState: Sign In menu is open and displays I'm a Client and I'm a Provider options.

scenarios.name: Open client sign-in page
scenarios.criteria: With the Sign In menu open, selecting I'm a Client opens the client sign-in page or client authentication interface.

scenarios.name: Verify client sign-in page controls
scenarios.criteria: The client sign-in page should display the Client Login heading, Email field, OTP delivery options for Email and SMS, and the Log in button.
scenarios.endState: Client sign-in page UI elements are verified.

scenarios.name: Select Email as OTP delivery method
scenarios.criteria: The user can select Email as the OTP delivery method on the client sign-in page.
scenarios.startState: Client sign-in page is open with OTP delivery options visible.
scenarios.endState: Email is selected as the OTP delivery method.

scenarios.name: Log in with Email OTP
scenarios.criteria: Using the configured valid client test email, selecting Email as the OTP delivery method, and clicking Log in opens the client OTP verification screen.
preconditions: Email is selected as the OTP delivery method.
scenarios.startState: Client sign-in page is open with Email as OTP delivery method.
scenarios.endState: Client OTP verification screen is open.

scenarios.name: Verify client OTP verification screen controls
scenarios.criteria: The client OTP verification screen should display the Enter Verification Code heading, OTP entry fields, resend code control or countdown, Verify button, and Back control.
preconditions: Client OTP verification screen is open.
scenarios.startState: Client OTP verification screen is open.
scenarios.endState: Client OTP verification screen UI elements are verified.

scenarios.name: Authenticate using OTP bypass
scenarios.criteria: Entering the configured client test OTP bypass value into the OTP verification fields and clicking Verify successfully authenticates the client and opens the authenticated client dashboard.
preconditions: Client OTP verification screen is open.
scenarios.startState: Client OTP verification screen is open.

scenarios.name: Log out from authenticated client dashboard
scenarios.criteria: After successful client authentication, the user can log out successfully and return to the public or client sign-in interface.
scenarios.endState: User is logged out and returned to the public or client sign-in interface.

scenarios.name: Open provider sign-in page from Sign In menu
scenarios.criteria: From the Healing Sky homepage, opening the Sign In menu and selecting I'm a Provider opens the provider sign-in page or provider authentication interface.

scenarios.name: Open Join Healing Sky options from navigation
scenarios.criteria: From the Healing Sky homepage, clicking Join Healing Sky in the main navigation opens the joining options and displays the Join as a Client option.
scenarios.endState: Join Healing Sky options are open.

scenarios.name: Open client registration page from Join Healing Sky options
scenarios.criteria: With the Join Healing Sky options open, selecting Join as a Client opens the client registration page or client registration interface.
preconditions: Join Healing Sky options are open.
scenarios.startState: Join Healing Sky options are open.

scenarios.name: Verify client registration interface
scenarios.criteria: The client registration interface should display the information fields and controls required to begin client registration.
scenarios.endState: Client registration interface fields and controls are verified.

scenarios.name: Begin client registration process
scenarios.criteria: The client registration interface provides a clear action such as Continue, Next, Register, or Submit to proceed with registration.
scenarios.startState: Client registration page is open with fields and controls verified.

scenarios.name: Open Join Healing Sky options from homepage hero
scenarios.criteria: From the Healing Sky homepage, clicking the Join Healing Sky call-to-action in the homepage hero section opens the joining options.
scenarios.endState: Join Healing Sky options are open from the homepage hero.

scenarios.name: Verify Join as a Client option in hero CTA
scenarios.criteria: With the joining options opened from the homepage hero section, the Join as a Client option is displayed.
preconditions: Join Healing Sky options are open from the homepage hero.
scenarios.startState: Join Healing Sky options are open from the homepage hero.
scenarios.endState: Join as a Client option is displayed in the hero CTA.

scenarios.name: Open client registration page from homepage hero options
scenarios.criteria: With the homepage hero joining options open, selecting Join as a Client opens the client registration page or client registration interface.
preconditions: Join Healing Sky options are open from the homepage hero section.
scenarios.startState: Join Healing Sky options are open from the homepage hero.
